title: 2021 NBA Finals - Wikipedia
snippet: The 2021 NBA Finals was the championship series of the National Basketball Association 's (NBA) 2020–21 season and conclusion of the season's playoffs. In this best-of-seven playoff series, the Eastern Conference champion Milwaukee Bucks overcame a two-games-to-none series deficit to defeat the Western Conference champion Phoenix Suns in six games, winning their first NBA championship since ...

title: 2021 NBA playoffs - Wikipedia
snippet: The Milwaukee Bucks became the second team in NBA playoff history to overcome an 0–2 deficit twice in the same postseason (2021 Los Angeles Clippers). The Milwaukee Bucks became the first team below the 2nd seed to win a championship since the Dallas Mavericks in 2011.
